stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Charter must be in position 2. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Charter must not be in position 2.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 2 such orders. "Charter must precede Decree." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- Essay → Charter → Poem → Speech → Decree
- Essay → Charter → Speech → Decree → Poem

distractorRationale.a: Even with the additional condition, Essay → Charter → Poem → Speech → Decree is permitted and makes this statement false.
